prompt: Point $B$ lies between $A$ and $C$ on a straight steel beam. If $AB = 2x$, $BC = x + 5$, and the whole beam $AC = 20$, find $x$.
hint: The two pieces have to add up to the whole beam: $AB + BC = AC$.

hints.text: The two pieces have to add up to the whole beam: $AB + BC = AC$.
Write the equation $2x + (x + 5) = 20$ and combine like terms.

explanation: Segment Addition gives $AB + BC = AC$, so $2x + x + 5 = 20$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check the pieces
steps: $10 + 10 = 20$, exactly the length of the beam. The value works.
